# Which eyeglass sales actually make money?

> Free calculator for optical shops and optometrists: what each eyeglass sale really earns after frame, lenses, remakes, vision plan and card fees and optician time. Margin by sale type, patient price for a target margin, plan vs cash, break-even sales. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
